groups.software: q1-q9: W0 and E (18 calls); q1-q8 primary, q9 separate
groups.extended: cardiac, research, evaluation, constructed80: W0, D, E, exact E repeat, cyclic rotated20 E (20 calls)
groups.navigation: five frozen targets: W0 and D (10 calls); E bypass is local only

arms.W0: pinned current production Score contract, first 40 post-group cards, complete original tail appended unchanged
arms.D_star: stable complete-pool ranking from Score answers in the same E batch; no separate provider call
arms.D: separate pinned EXP-040 ordinal-only purpose Score, extended-pool diagnostic only
arms.E: same-batch D Score plus typed Noul answers for every explicit facet/candidate pair and frozen deterministic selector

limits.preflight: estimates only; actual token gates apply after response and cannot cap in-flight spend

fallback: Any invalid/oversize request or response, timeout, usage gate, or expiry preserves the complete W0 order; no truncation, chunking, retries, or cross-call score fusion.
grouping: Apply pinned scholarly-work-v3 group_publications to a single synthetic frozen_projection feed. This is not engine provenance. Preserve all original member IDs and project only the selected original representative row; never merge labels, snippets, scores, or references.

selector.algorithm: stable score sort; while an eligible outside candidate adds missing model-qualified facets, greedily select the candidate covering the most uncovered facets (then score descending, then request order), evict the lowest-score selected non-reservation that is not the sole qualified representative of an already covered facet (eviction ties later request order), reserve the inserted card; stop after four insertions or no safe insertion; stable-sort the selected set by score and append remaining cards in stable score order

analysis.primary: E minus W0 development screen for q1-q8, both EXP-039 references independently; paired query bootstrap 10000 draws seed 91940; mean nDCG@10 >= 0.03 and lower95 > 0
analysis.selector_quality: E minus D* mean nDCG@10 >= -0.01 per reference; per-query useful loss <= 1 and E retains >=9 when comparator has 10; preserve all reference-supported useful facets vs W0 and D*
analysis.natural_pools: same useful/facet guards and per-pool nDCG loss <= 0.03 vs D*; E vs D separately descriptive
analysis.coverage: macro coverage@10 on facets with >=1 post-group representative tagged by that reference and lead>=2; E >= D* for each reference and strict aggregate improvement under at least one; zero-evaluable cases excluded and reported
analysis.navigation: pinned exact target top3 under W0 and D; E bypass must not reorder
analysis.stress: constructed80 is operational only; post-v3 grouping yields 79 candidates, not 80; no relevance claims
analysis.references: reuse sealed EXP-039/EXP-040 reference rows unchanged for original representative only; no relabel/aggregation
